# {{name}}

{{description}}

No dependency installation is needed.

- `node tools/build.mjs` builds the app.
- `node --test tests/app.test.mjs` checks the scaffold.
- `node tools/serve.mjs` opens a loopback-only server; browse to http://127.0.0.1:4173 and stop it with Ctrl+C.

This scaffold is not browser, security or accessibility acceptance evidence.
